feel: Flat textures, standard brightness, 125 fps cap

provenance.changes: 130 of 341 lines were left out: chat lines, passwords and logins, the player’s name, file paths and hardware details, server hosting settings, settings of other games and settings the game protects.

story: configs.eu lists this file under Team Pandemic. The hardware it names suggests 2005 to 2008; the page gives no date. The second of two files published for this player. Sensitivity can’t be compared between players without the mouse’s DPI, which the file doesn’t give.
